title: Source: Coinbase is targeting H1 2027 to begin offering in-house event contracts in the US; it currently offers prediction markets through a Kalshi partnership (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Source: Coinbase is targeting H1 2027 to begin offering in-house event contracts in the US; it currently offers prediction markets through a Kalshi partnership — Coinbase Global Inc. is targeting the first half of 2027 to begin offering in-house event contracts in the US, according to a person familiar with the matter.
